settings.reset-confirm: Reset every saved setting and restore the defaults?
settings.log.title: Diagnostic log
settings.log.hint: Every run is recorded here. File paths are never written, so the log can be shared as is.
settings.error.save: The setting could not be saved
settings.share.title: Share target
settings.share.tip:
• The share target is the service a finished file is uploaded to.
• storage.to carries up to 25 GiB and lets VidShrink delete the file, so a link can be closed early.
• uguu.se carries up to 128 MiB and clears itself after 3 hours, but it hands out no delete token, so nobody can close the link early.
settings.share.delete.disabled-tip: No shared file to delete yet
settings.share.can-delete: {0} hands out a delete token, so a link can be closed before its lifetime runs out. The button works once a file has been shared.
settings.share.no-delete-window: {0} hands out no delete token, so neither you nor VidShrink can close the link early. Its own deletion after {1} hours stands in for that.
settings.share.no-delete: {0} hands out no delete token, so neither you nor VidShrink can close the link early.
settings.share.nothing: There is no file to share.
settings.share.targets-missing: The share targets could not be read; {0} was not found.
settings.share.shared-until: Shared. The link stays open until {0}.
settings.share.failed: The file could not be shared
settings.share.close-failed: The share could not be closed
settings.share.upload-busy: An upload is already running; wait for it to finish or cancel it.
settings.share.nothing-to-close: There is no share to close.
settings.update.title: Updates
settings.update.auto-effect: Off by default: a new version is announced in the top bar and installed with a button. When on, VidShrink updates quietly.
settings.update.no-self-effect: VidShrink does not update itself on this system: it only tells you that a new version exists and shows the command that installs it.
settings.default-app.suggestion: VidShrink is not the default program for videos. You can pick it on the Windows Default apps page.
settings.player-shortcuts.title: Player shortcuts
settings.player-shortcuts.hint: The player tab, its menu and this list all read the same table.
settings-tab.opensubtitles.label: OpenSubtitles API key
settings-tab.opensubtitles.hint: Subtitle download in the player uses your own key. Create a free consumer account at opensubtitles.com, then paste the key here. Without a key the feature stays off.
settings-tab.opensubtitles.signedout: Not signed in — subtitle downloads need an account
settings-tab.opensubtitles.signinfailed: Sign-in failed. Check the username, password and API key.
settings-tab.opensubtitles.accounthint: The password is only sent to OpenSubtitles to sign in and is never saved. Only the session token that comes back is stored, protected by Windows; on other systems the session lasts until you close VidShrink.
share.error.too-large-no-target: The file is {0}; {1} accepts at most {2}. No target on the list has a high enough ceiling, so the target size has to come down.
share.error.too-large-try: The file is {0}; {1} accepts at most {2}. {3} accepts this size ({4}).
share.error.server-too-large: {0} found the file too large; its ceiling is {1}. Lower the target size and try again.
share.error.rate-limited: {0} received too many requests. Anonymous uploads have a daily count limit; try again after a while.
share.error.rate-limited-wait: {0} received too many requests. You can try again in {1}.
share.error.forbidden: {0} refused the request. This happens when the delete token does not belong to this file or the file was removed; the link may already be closed.
share.error.unauthorized: {0} treated the request as unauthorised. This version expects anonymous uploads; the service may have changed its rules.
share.error.gone: The file is no longer on {0} — it either expired or was already deleted. It has been dropped from the record.
share.error.timeout: {0} did not answer in time. Check your connection and try again.
share.error.unavailable: {0} is not serving right now. Try the other target, or look again in a little while.
share.error.unavailable-wait: {0} is not serving right now. You can try again in {1}.
share.error.storage-full: {0} storage is full. Try the other target.
share.error.server-fault: {0} returned a server error during {1} ({2}). You can try the other target.
share.error.bad-request: {0} did not understand the request ({1}). The service may have changed its interface; try the other target.
share.error.unexpected: {0} gave an unexpected answer during {1} ({2}). The server offered no explanation of its own.
share.error.unexpected-detail: {0} gave an unexpected answer during {1} ({2}). The server's own explanation: {3}
share.error.cancelled: The upload was cancelled. No half file was left on the server.
share.error.host-not-found: The address of {0} could not be resolved. The service may have shut down or be unreachable from this network; try the other target.
share.error.connect-failed: Could not connect to the {0} server. Check your network connection and try again.
share.error.unreachable: The {0} server could not be reached. Check your network connection and try again.
share.error.file-missing: The file to upload was not found. The conversion output may have been moved or deleted.
share.error.file-locked: The file could not be read; another program may be holding it open.
share.error.disk-full: There is no space left on the local disk.
share.error.connection-dropped: The connection to {0} dropped during {1}. Try again.
share.error.no-delete-token-hours: {0} does not hand out a delete token, so the link cannot be closed early; automatic deletion after {1} hours takes its place.
share.error.no-delete-token: {0} does not hand out a delete token, so the link cannot be closed early; the file is deleted when its own lifetime runs out.
share.error.token-lost: We do not have this file's delete token, so the link cannot be closed early on {0}. The file is deleted when its own lifetime runs out.
